back_translation: The word of the LORD that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, son of Gedaliah, son of Amariah, son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah.
'I will utterly sweep away everything from the face of the ground,' declares the LORD.

'I will sweep away both man and beast; I will sweep away the birds of the sky and the fish of the sea, together with the stumbling-blocks along with the wicked. I will cut off mankind from the face of the ground,' declares the LORD.

'I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off from this place the remnant of Baal, together with the name of the idolatrous priests along with the priests,
and those who go up to bow down to the host of heaven on the rooftops, and those who bow down and swear by the LORD yet also swear by Milcom,
and those who turn back from following the LORD, and who do not seek the LORD nor inquire of Him.'
Be silent before the Lord GOD, for the day of the LORD is near. Indeed, the LORD has prepared a sacrifice; He has consecrated His invited guests.
'And on the day of the LORD's sacrifice I will punish the officials and the king's sons, and all who dress in foreign clothing.
On that day I will punish all who leap over the threshold, who fill the house of their masters with violence and deceit.
'And on that day,' declares the LORD, 'a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, a wailing from the Second Quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.
'Wail, O inhabitants of the Maktesh, for all the merchants are destroyed; all who weigh out silver are cut off.
At that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish the men who lie settled on their dregs, who say in their hearts, 'The LORD will do neither good nor harm.'
Their wealth will be plundered and their houses laid waste. They will build houses but not live in them, and plant vineyards but not drink their wine.'
The great day of the LORD is near—near and hastening swiftly. Listen! The sound of the day of the LORD is bitter; even the warrior cries out there.
That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of ruin and devastation, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and thick darkness,
a day of trumpet blast and battle cry against the fortified cities and against the high corner towers.
'I will bring distress on mankind, so that they walk like the blind, because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.

Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them on the day of the LORD's wrath. The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy, for He will make a sudden and complete end of all who dwell on the earth.'
